targetText: Accumulation of Money Whether or not m, the surplus-value turned into money, is immediately added to the capital-value in process and is thus enabled to enter the circuit together with capital M now having the magnitude M', depends on circumstances which are independent of the mere existence of m.
explanation: The circuit of capital describes how value transforms from money capital into productive assets (machinery/labor) and commodity capital, returning as expanded money capital.

targetText: But in the interim it is accumulated and exists only in the shape of a hoard in process of formation, of growth.
explanation: Hoarding money capital is a necessary phase under capitalism to accumulate sufficient reserves before purchasing large fixed assets or expanding production.
